scope.summary: Implement the non-destructive distortion constructs: Free Distort (drag four corner points), Perspective distort (map onto a perspective plane/mockup), Envelope Distort (warp preset / custom mesh / top object; fidelity + gradient/pattern-distortion options), Warp group (live perspective/quad/mesh wrapping editable children), Puppet Warp (pin-and-drag mesh), and Liquify-family warps (warp/twirl/pucker/bloat/scallop/crystallize/wrinkle). All wrapping constructs provide an edit-contents mode that edits underlying source geometry while the distortion applies live, plus explicit expand; distorting a gradient/pattern fill honors a distort-with-geometry option.
expected_tests: argus: distortion constructs reachable via author_id
test: envelope/warp/puppet/perspective/liquify apply live; edit-contents edits source while distortion holds; explicit expand bakes; fill distort-with-geometry option honored
acceptance_criteria_original: distortion constructs live + edit-contents + explicit expand + fill-distort option; author_ids + manual entry

target_entries: Studio / Vector / Distortions (envelope, warp, puppet, perspective, liquify)

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-VEC-030]** Studio MUST provide the deduped transform and distortion set below. Each is a typed operation available identically to operator and model. Live/envelope distortions MUST be non-destructive constructs whose contents remain editable until explicitly expanded. *Derivation: catalogue table, splits per row; yields 8 microtasks, one per transform or distortion construct. Anchors appearing in this table's cells are cross-references to clauses defined as paragraphs elsewhere in this sub-section; they are NOT clause definitions and yield no microtask here.* | Studio transform | Function (normative) | Parameter contract | |---|---|---| | Move / rotate / scale / reflect / shear | Affine transforms about a settable reference point, with per-object randomised transform-each | [STU-VEC-157] | | Free transform | Combined on-canvas move/scale/rotate/shear with constrain and perspective/distort modifiers | [STU-VEC-157] | | Free distort | Reshape by dragging four corner points of a distortion frame | [STU-VEC-155] | | Perspective distort | Map artwork onto a perspective plane or mockup surface | [STU-VEC-172] | | Envelope distort | Wrap artwork in an editable envelope from a warp preset, a custom mesh grid or a top object | [STU-VEC-168], [STU-VEC-169] | | Warp group | Live perspective/quad/mesh warp wrapping children that stay editable | [STU-VEC-169] | | Puppet warp | Pin-and-drag mesh deformation of a single object | [STU-VEC-172] | | Liquify-family warps | Warp, twirl, pucker, bloat, scallop, crystallize, wrinkle brush distortions | [STU-VEC-170] |

**[STU-VEC-055]** All distortion constructs that wrap editable content MUST provide an edit-contents mode that lets the operator or model edit the underlying source geometry while the distortion continues to apply live, and an explicit expand that bakes the distorted result. Distorting a gradient or pattern fill MUST honour the two independent captured booleans of [STU-VEC-169] (`distort_linear_gradient_fills`, `distort_pattern_fills`); they are SEPARATE options and MUST NOT be merged into one "distort fills" flag.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
